cohort.source: Chinese longevity cohort, peripheral blood transcriptomes, Hainan/Hubei/Hunan (Xiao et al., Cell Reports Medicine 7:102767, 2026; collaborative sharing)
cohort.chronological_age_protocol: train/validate on M band + 50y edge of Y, n=760; L band participates in auxiliary band supervision only

protocol.split_kind: random 80/20, master seed 2026, identical rows for every method
protocol.test: two-sided paired Wilcoxon over the 15 replicate errors
protocol.multiplicity: Holm step-down inside two pre-registered families (10 classical baselines; 4-arm deep suite)
protocol.features: pooled HVG8000 screen, selected inside training folds

model.deep_member: compact residual MLP; cross-fitted ridge-residual anchor with bounded tanh correction; FiLM sex conditioning; three-band auxiliary head (L band auxiliary only); RankNet-style monotonicity regularizer lambda=0.05 (pre-registered)
model.composition: selected by exhaustive 15-subset matrix on the locked splits (x48); no rival significantly better (nearest deep+EN-40 +0.007, p=0.36)

frozen_numbers.prior_value_same_backbone: +0.30 y (CraneZ-vanilla 6.044 vs eq3' 5.740, 15/15 splits, Holm p=9.2e-05)
frozen_numbers.vs_published_clock: 6.52 (Xiao et al. random-split protocol); locked estimate 0.78 y lower (12.0%)

component_costs.band-aux: +0.003 (p=0.60, ns; structural value via collapse control 10.714)

frozen_numbers.external: relative-ordering claims only; core3 linear core lowest point estimate at k=5/10/20 on both cohorts; ext2 all cells significant (p<=0.033); ext1 k>=10 significant (p<=1e-4); ext1 k=5 vs SVR-500 n.s. (disclosed)

rule: every paper number is read from these frozen tables; nothing is recomputed after evaluation
